entries.headline: South Carolina nuclear-site emergency ended and restrictions lifted
entries.summary: War Watch reported that a fire at a nuclear facility in South Carolina prompted FAA airspace restrictions. It said the emergency had since been terminated and the restrictions lifted, citing the latest updates.

entries.headline: ASTRA report on Izium guided-bomb attack highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an ASTRA report stating that ten people were injured in a Russian guided aerial-bomb attack on Izium in the Kharkiv region. It said the report preceded a wire-service report by 76 minutes and was later confirmed by two outlets. The quoted text was truncated after “with four possibly…”

entries.headline: GOOSE11 V-22 Osprey sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of V-22 Osprey GOOSE11, registration 168030 and hex AE4E49. The sighting was credited to TruthSeekr60.

entries.headline: Starshield slowdown air-defence report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a report from @charlottewilliams922 bearing the headline “Ukraine air defense hold during Starshield slowdown.” No further detail was visible in the post.

entries.headline: U.S. cargo, presidential and command aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six military cargo aircraft over the United States, along with a presidential aircraft and a nuclear command aircraft observed in recent hours. It also referred to an earlier fire at a South Carolina nuclear site; the visible post was truncated at that point.

entries.headline: Al Jazeera Arabic report on Houthi attack highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Al Jazeera Arabic report stating that Yemeni government forces said they had repelled a Houthi attack. It said the report preceded a wire-service report by 57 minutes and was later confirmed by two outlets. The quoted location was truncated after “Ras…”

entries.headline: BLKCAT5 MQ-4C Triton sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of MQ-4C Triton BLKCAT5, registration 169659 and hex AE7812, leaving NS Mayport. The sighting was credited to JessiDavin.

entries.headline: Suspilne report on Kharkiv drone strike highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Suspilne report stating that a drone struck an educational institution in Kharkiv’s Saltivskyi district, citing Mayor Terekhov. It said the report preceded a wire-service report by 34 minutes and was later confirmed by two outlets. The quoted text was truncated after naming the mayor.

entries.headline: U.S. military air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple large U.S. military transport aircraft, a reconnaissance aircraft and a nuclear command aircraft airborne over the United States. It said this followed a fire at a South Carolina nuclear…; the visible post was truncated at that point.

entries.headline: EAM header code WEFZ6O reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported an Emergency Action Message header or preamble with header code WEFZ6O.

entries.headline: EAM header code WEFZ6U reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported an Emergency Action Message header or preamble with header code WEFZ6U.

entries.headline: ADFDF9 VC-25A sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of a Boeing VC-25A with no call sign, registration 92-9000 and hex ADFDF9. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: BACE2026 four-field business-jet total revisited
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that 1,040 distinct business jets moved through four Las Vegas fields during BACE2026 show week. It said the RampWatch board prompted conversations, including direct-message feedback that ramp personnel wanted views of their own traffic, and linked to a replay.

entries.headline: BACE week business-jet totals reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 1,040 distinct business jets in the Las Vegas valley during BACE2026 week, with activity peaking at 306 on Thursday before falling 19% on Friday. It shared a reel covering six days of after-action reports.

entries.headline: BACE departure-heavy traffic reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 309 departures and 154 arrivals on its Las Vegas valley counter by 2:30 p.m. ET as BACE2026 wrapped Friday, saying there were about two departures for every arrival. It shared a 60-times-speed replay.

entries.headline: BACE Friday business-jet activity comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity down 19% Friday compared with Thursday as BACE2026 wrapped and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: BACE business-jet arrivals and impact estimated
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 935 business-jet arrivals, 52% above a normal October week, and estimated that they represented about $13.5 million of BACE2026's roughly $50 million Las Vegas impact.

entries.headline: BACE departure surge reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 259 departures from four Las Vegas-area fields by 1:43 p.m. ET, compared with 116 arrivals, and shared a time-lapse covering 10:17 a.m. to 1:29 p.m. ET.

entries.headline: BACE departure and arrival counts shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 120 departures and 48 arrivals across four Las Vegas fields by 12:15 p.m. ET on Thursday during BACE2026, and shared a 30-times-speed replay.

entries.headline: BACE Thursday traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity up 10% while overall Las Vegas valley traffic fell 3% on Thursday compared with Wednesday, and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: Las Vegas field departure count reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 243 aircraft still on the ground across four Las Vegas fields at 10:16 a.m. ET Friday, with 61 already departed.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE peak-hour replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay covering 28 minutes of Wednesday’s NBAA-BACE peak traffic across Harry Reid, Henderson, North Las Vegas and Boulder City, followed by a valley-wide view.

entries.headline: N871CB Boulder City arrival replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared the Wednesday NBAA-BACE arrival of Citation CJ2 N871CB into Boulder City, showing the approach at ten-times speed and the touchdown in real time.

entries.headline: Henderson NBAA-BACE business-jet traffic reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 81 business jets at Henderson on Wednesday during NBAA-BACE, compared with 172 at Harry Reid, highlighting overflow traffic handled by the valley’s reliever airfields.
